svg.title: KAL generative-UI architecture with agent, server, DB split, and the host holding three symbols including the agent URL
svg.desc: The KAL brand bundle authors the catalog ID, adapter, agent, server, and database. The super-app host registers three symbols — KAL_ID, the adapter, and the agent URL — and POSTs user messages to that URL, rendering the A2UI streamed back. The backend splits into LLM orchestrator, MCP gate for hard rules, MCP execution tools, and a database reachable only through the server.
svg.text: KAL brand bundle — published by Korean Air
